source='''def transform(grid):
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row if value != 0}
    pieces = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in cells), max(r for r, _ in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells)
        piece = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
        pieces.append((r0, c0, piece))
    rows = [r for r, _, _ in pieces]
    cols = [c for _, c, _ in pieces]
    vertical = max(rows) - min(rows) > max(cols) - min(cols)
    pieces.sort(key=lambda item: item[0 if vertical else 1])
    if vertical:
        width = max(len(piece[0]) for _, _, piece in pieces)
        height = sum(len(piece) for _, _, piece in pieces)
        out = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]
        offset = 0
        for _, _, piece in pieces:
            for r, row in enumerate(piece):
                out[offset + r][:len(row)] = row
            offset += len(piece)
    else:
        height = max(len(piece) for _, _, piece in pieces)
        width = sum(len(piece[0]) for _, _, piece in pieces)
        out = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]
        offset = 0
        for _, _, piece in pieces:
            for r, row in enumerate(piece):
                out[r][offset:offset + len(row)] = row
            offset += len(piece[0])
    return out
'''
